g.text: A vote-to-jail addon for SoF1: keep a griefer in spectator for the map, kick if they hop back in.
`.rcon jail <slot>` · admin opens a vote, via spf_sv_rcon command table
`.jail` · any player adds one vote, deduped per slot
`_spf_sv_rcon_jailed_voted_<slot>` · one vote per slot, cleared per vote
`_spf_sv_jail_iplist` · comma-joined prisoner IPs, the map's memory
spf_sv_rcon_jail · bounds-check slot, refuse a second vote, seed count at 1
vote_loop · 5 s tick: 3 votes wins, 30 s timeout loses, map change ends it
jail_loop · 2.5 s sweep: force spectate, count the hop, kick past maxlives
on_cl_join · IP match against iplist, instant re-jail without extra lives
`.jail` handler · rejects the starter and repeat voters, increments count
sp_sc_timer2 + unHex · carry an argument list through a space-splitting timer
SoFPlus script API · cvars, timers, list helpers, printing
players · receive broadcast vote prompts and prison messages
admin vote is the first of three
prisoner added to the sweep set
returning prisoner lands back in spec
votes arrive while the tick runs
